style: 2D hand-drawn animated film in the manner of a gothic storybook: confident clean ink outlines, cel-shaded colour over painted gouache textures, richly detailed backgrounds, warm amber firelight against the cold blue of a rainy night, deep soft shadows, fluid full animation at 24 frames. England, 1902.
sheet_style: Character design for a 2D hand-drawn animated film: confident clean ink outlines, cel-shaded colour with a light gouache texture, even neutral studio light.

white.name: Mr White
white.look: a thin man of sixty with a bald crown, grey hair at the sides, a long grey moustache and small round spectacles, in a dark green knitted cardigan over a white collarless shirt, brown trousers and slippers

herbert.name: Herbert
herbert.look: a tall cheerful young man of twenty-two with tousled chestnut hair, clean-shaven, in a white shirt with rolled sleeves, a mustard waistcoat and dark trousers

morris.name: Sergeant-Major Morris
morris.look: a burly soldier of fifty-five with a ruddy weathered face, a thick white walrus moustache and side whiskers, short grey hair, in a long rain-soaked navy military greatcoat with brass buttons and a red scarf

parlour.name: the parlour
parlour.look: a small Victorian parlour at night: a brick fireplace with a burning fire on the right, a tall sash window streaming with rain on the left, a round wooden table with a chessboard and an oil lamp in the middle, two wooden chairs, a worn armchair, faded patterned wallpaper, a door to the hall at the back

paw.name: the monkey's paw
paw.look: a small mummified monkey's paw no bigger than a child's hand, dark brown and shrivelled, with thin curled fingers and black nails

beats.scene: A quiet evening at home while a storm beats on the house.
shots: seen from outside through the rain-streaked window, the camera slowly pushes in to the parlour, where Mr White and Herbert sit over a chessboard by the fire; Herbert moves a piece and grins, Mr White frowns at the board and strokes his moustache
beats.audio: heavy rain on glass, a fire crackling, the click of a chess piece

beats.scene: A knock at the door: an old friend has come back from India.
shots: Mr White and Herbert at the chess table both turn their heads sharply toward the door at the back
the door swings open and Sergeant-Major Morris fills the doorway in his dripping greatcoat, rain and a flash of lightning behind him; Mr White rises and grips his hand warmly
beats.audio: three knocks on wood, rain, a roll of thunder, a door creaking

beats.scene: The soldier shows what he brought from India.
shots: close on the round table: Sergeant-Major Morris's big hand draws the monkey's paw out of his coat pocket and sets it down beside the chessboard under the oil lamp; Mr White and Herbert lean in over it, their faces lit from below
beats.audio: rain, fire crackling, a dry little thud on wood

beats.scene: The soldier tells the paw's story and it frightens him.
shots: medium close-up of Sergeant-Major Morris by the fire, his face grave and gone pale, slowly holding up three fingers as he talks, firelight flickering on him
Mr White and Herbert listen across the table, the monkey's paw lying in the foreground; Herbert's smile fades
beats.audio: rain, low fire, wind in the chimney

beats.scene: The soldier tries to destroy the paw and his host saves it.
shots: Sergeant-Major Morris flings the monkey's paw into the fireplace, sparks burst up
Mr White drops to one knee at the hearth and snatches the smoking paw out of the glowing coals, holding it up, Morris stares at him aghast
beats.audio: a whoosh of flame, sparks, rain

beats.scene: A warning, then the soldier leaves.
shots: Sergeant-Major Morris grips Mr White by the shoulder and points sternly at Mr White's right hand, which holds the monkey's paw
Morris turns up his collar in the open doorway and walks out into the pouring night, the door swinging shut behind him
beats.audio: rain getting louder as the door opens, the door shutting, fire

beats.scene: The son makes light of it.
shots: Herbert leans on the table laughing, rubbing thumb and fingers together for money and nodding at the walls of the house; Mr White sits looking doubtfully at the monkey's paw in his hand
beats.audio: fire crackling, rain, a chair creaking

shots: low angle: Mr White stands up before the fire, raises the monkey's paw high in his clenched right fist and calls out, his mouth moving; the fire flares and huge shadows leap across the wallpaper; Herbert watches from the table
beats.audio: the fire roaring up, thunder, rain

shots: extreme close-up of Mr White's open right palm: the monkey's paw twists and its thin fingers curl like a snake
Mr White cries out, eyes wide, and drops it; the paw falls to the floorboards
beats.audio: a dry creaking, a thud on wood, rain

shots: the monkey's paw lies on the bare floorboards in the foreground; behind it Mr White and Herbert look around the empty floor, Herbert spreads his hands and shrugs
Herbert, grinning, claps Mr White on the shoulder, points up toward the ceiling, takes a lit candle from the table and walks to the door at the back
beats.audio: footsteps on boards, fire low, rain

beats.scene: The house has gone to bed. One man stays.
shots: wide shot of the darkened parlour: Mr White sits alone in the armchair before a fire burned down to red embers, rain running down the window, the camera slowly pushing in on his still figure
beats.audio: embers ticking, soft rain, a clock

shots: close-up in red ember-light of Mr White's hand resting on the arm of the chair, holding the monkey's paw; its fingers twitch and tremble; his thumb tightens over it
beats.audio: embers ticking, a faint dry scratching

shots: close on the glowing coals in the fireplace: a grinning monkey's face forms in the embers, its eyes burning brighter
Mr White recoils in the armchair, seizes a glass of water from the table and throws it on the fire; steam bursts up and the room goes dark
beats.audio: a low hiss, a sharp hiss of steam, silence
